title: Chapter 1368
text:
On a certain artificially modified planet in the Flickering World, the silver land paved with engineering alloys was boundless, wrapping around the entire planet. There were no buildings built on the ground, and the entire planet was a round silver sphere. Only the most basic geological modification had been done.

Hundreds of Beyond Grade As stayed in the center of the vast silver plain, their eyes were always focused on Han Xiao's back.

In order to reduce unexpected factors, the three Universal Civilizations chose a planet in their territory as the venue for the Sanctum Revival. Many Beyond Grade As followed Han Xiao over using the teleportation device.

The three Universal Civilizations did not set up a fleet in the outer space of the planet. They only installed space stabilization anchors and deployed secret over-the-horizon weapons in more distant locations. They used remote equipment to observe the situation here, so the outer space of the planet looked empty without any armed forces.

This was based on Han Xiao's suggestion. All Beyond Grade As had a temper. If they were forced to negotiate as soon as they woke up, they would definitely be unhappy, and it might not be beneficial to contact them. This time, the three Universal Civilizations had a favor to ask of others. The other party was all historical powerhouses with respectable identities, so it was not suitable for them to show such a tough attitude from the start. On the contrary, the communication between Beyond Grade As was not hindered.

If physical persuasion was needed, he and a group of Beyond Grade As would be enough. Only the strong would be respected. This was the default rule between Beyond Grade As. If military forces were to intervene, it might have the opposite effect.

"Then I'll begin."

Han Xiao looked back. Seeing that everyone nodded, indicating that they had no objections, he retracted his gaze and activated the Sanctum Revival mark on the back of his hand.

A golden light suddenly bloomed and shot out like a thread, condensing into glowing bodies on the plain in front of everyone. They slowly materialized and turned into life forms with different appearances. The energy fluctuations resonated with each other, as if a storm had appeared out of thin air, blowing everyone's hair and clothes.

The Beyond Grade As stared at this scene, afraid that they would miss a single scene.

"They're alive!"

"So this is how they're revived. It's different from what I thought. I thought there would be some kind of incubation process."

"Speaking of which, what's the principle behind this? It looks amazing."

A series of surprised whispers came from behind, but Han Xiao pretended not to hear them and carefully observed this batch of reviving targets.

"The direct descendants of the three Universal Civilizations, the direct descendants of the Supercluster, and the neutral Beyond Grade As … The structure of the Revivors this time is more complicated than the previous two times, and the conflict is probably more intense."

Han Xiao mentally prepared himself.

At this moment, the revivors seemed to have woken up from a dream. They went from being dazed to confused, and then from being confused to surprised. They observed their own condition and their surroundings in bewilderment and started sizing each other up.

"What's going on?"

"Hallucination? Dreamland? Virtual world? What did the Radiant Federation do to me? "

"Hmm? It's you! I crushed your head with my own hands. How are you still alive?! "

After this batch of revivors saw the situation around them clearly, the scene gradually became chaotic. Waves of aura emerged from their bodies, and their energy quickly entered an unstable active state. They entered battle mode, and many people who had grudges with each other were ready to make a move. As for some of the neutrals who had yet to figure out the situation, they frowned and quietly retreated to the side. Their visual organs spun around, wanting to observe first.

Han Xiao was about to speak to show his existence, but at this moment, a tall male life form looked over and stared at Han Xiao and the others.

He slowly said, "If I'm not wrong, we're all dead. Were you the ones who revived us?"

He was wearing a gorgeous priest's robe, and his voice was solemn and ancient. With a calming aura, he quickly suppressed the chaos in the crowd and guided the gazes of all the revivors to focus on him. Then, they followed his gaze and locked onto Han Xiao and the others.

You're stealing my lines?

Han Xiao looked at him carefully and filtered through the database with his consciousness. Very soon, he found the information of this man who spoke.

Hilbert Mueller, a direct descendant of the Arcane Church, a peak Beyond Grade A Esper. His ability was related to space, and he was once the supreme pillar of the Arcane Church. He was even more senior and was the previous owner of the Ethereal National Treasure, Wuornos!

Because Wuornos' ability was more suitable for the Ethereal National Treasure, after Wuornos grew up, the Arcane Church changed the owner of the National Treasure. Hilbert left his position as the supreme pillar and changed his position to explore the secondary dimensions. He disappeared during a long voyage, and no one knew if he was alive or dead.

From the looks of it, this guy had naturally kicked the bucket. The universe was so big, and there were endless dangers. No one knew what he had encountered in the secondary dimensions, but the possibility of it being the Celestial Star Alliance could be ruled out. Han Xiao had once learned the appearances and names of the first three batches of 'outsiders' from Jayz. Those people were not in his revival choices for the time being.

Various thoughts flashed through Han Xiaoxin's mind, and he nodded.

"That's right. I'm sure you still have your memories. You've all died long ago and become history. It's now Galaxy Calendar Year 783, and many years have passed. I used a method called Sanctum Revival to wake you up …"

"It's actually revival …"

"Unbelievable. There's such a thing?"

"I thought someone had uploaded my remnant consciousness into the virtual world."

The revivors quietened down and were surprised.

They had never thought of such a thing. At least, when they died, not many of them thought that they would wake up one day.

At this time, a female dynasty human in military uniform narrowed her eyes and asked Han Xiao, "Who are you?"

"Then who are you?"

"You can call me Black Star, the current only controller of the Sanctum Revival, the joint consultant of the three Universal Civilizations, and the current Beyond Grade A President." Han Xiao introduced himself and added with a smile, "I was once an ally of the dynasty. Speaking of which, we should be closer, Your Excellency Reeve."

"Is that so? Then you're one of us?"

Reeve's expression softened slightly.

She was once one of the pillars of the dynasty, a peak Beyond Grade A Mage, nicknamed the 'Fairy Empress', and her combat strength was outstanding.

Hearing Han Xiao's title, it sounded like he was on the same side as the three Universal Civilizations, and at the same time, the other party claimed to be an ally of the dynasty. Reeve felt that he was most likely not an enemy.

She turned to observe the Beyond Grade As behind Han Xiao. Suddenly, her gaze stopped on Clottey, and a surprised smile appeared on her face.

"Isn't this Little Dark? You're still alive?"

Everyone looked over and saw the usually cold Clottey's face twitching slightly. He quietly moved his feet, as if he wanted to hide himself in the crowd.

"Hey, Clottey! Don't pretend you don't know me. I see you. Where are you hiding? "

Reeve put her hands on her hips and roared like a lion.

Han Xiao could not help but rub his buzzing ears. He felt that this woman must have a lot in common with Sun Hunter.

"… We meet again."

A rare look of reluctance flashed across Clottey's face, but he still braced himself and replied.

In terms of seniority, Reeve was his senior. She had once taught him with the other National Pillars for a period of time. When Clottey was not strong yet, she had left a deep psychological shadow in him. She could be considered half a teacher.

What made Clottey's scalp go numb the most was that Reeve would usually touch him and deliberately tease him.

Speaking of which, Reeve could be considered a flirtatious beauty. If it was under normal circumstances, he would not have avoided her, but the problem was … this guy was an acquired transsexual. It was not a situation where she was forced to do so like Lotus Swordsman, but a choice of her own accord. Furthermore, it was not a decision made when she was weak. She actually changed her sex after becoming a Beyond Grade A. The reason was strange. In Reeve's words, "I'm tired of being a man, so I'll try being a woman."

Although the galactic era was open, and transsexualism was widely accepted, Clottey had never liked new trends. He could accept it if they interacted normally, but when he was teased, he instinctively felt a chill run down his spine. He really could not accept it. This mentality was probably …

I treat you as a brother, and you actually want to sleep with me?

"Ahem, everyone, now is not the time to exchange pleasantries."

Han Xiao hurriedly interrupted the conversation between the two of them. They had not finished talking about serious matters. If he let these people who were related to each other recognize each other now, how long would they have to talk?

"Hmm, that's true. Let's not talk about anything else first. You must have revived us for some purpose. What's going on?"

The Revivor of the Radiant Federation also spoke at the right time. This was a Psychic, a direct descendant of Oulou.

The ones who asked the questions were basically the direct descendants of the three Universal Civilizations. They spontaneously gathered together, while the other revivors watched the two sides communicate and silently obtained information. As for the ten Supercluster direct descendants, they shrank to the side and maintained an extremely high level of vigilance.

Hearing this question, everyone was energized. This was what they were most vigilant about, afraid that they would be revived for some bad intentions.

"Reviving everyone is not just my intention. It is also the intention of the three Universal Civilizations, the galactic society, and all the Beyond Grade As present." Han Xiao paused for a moment before saying with a deep voice, "Everyone's hometown has encountered a huge crisis. An external Universal Civilization is invading our world. Their strength is beyond imagination, and they are extremely powerful. The war has already broken out. We need everyone's strength!"

A Universe-level war?

Everyone's expressions changed, and they all had their own thoughts.

That was true. If it was not a crisis of this level, there did not seem to be a need to spend so much effort to revive so many historical Beyond Grade As. However, from a personal point of view, knowing that they would have to participate in a high-intensity galactic war as soon as they were revived, most of the revivors were unhappy that they had been used.

The revivors looked at the hundreds of Beyond Grade As on the other side and finally understood the situation. The joy of being revived was swept away, and a faint anger arose in their hearts.

A neutral Beyond Grade A frowned and said with dissatisfaction, "If we're not willing, what will happen? Will you use force to force us?"

Han Xiao shook his head and said, "That's not the case. We will try our best to persuade everyone. Everything is voluntary, and we will not force you to participate in the war."

After all, the revivors were individuals with free thoughts, not slaves. Coercion was not advisable, not only because of the complicated identities of the revivors but also because of the feelings of the other Beyond Grade As.

Pointing a gun at the revivors' heads and forcing them to compromise would cause many repercussions. One of them was to make the other Beyond Grade As feel the same way and worry that they would receive the same treatment after reviving in the future. Then, it would be hard to say how many association members would be willing to continue participating in the war.

However, there would definitely not be many revivors who would listen to him if he only used words to persuade them, and force was an indispensable part. It was difficult to deal with both sides, and this was even more difficult to deal with than the previous two revivals. Han Xiao had long been mentally prepared for this.

This time, a Beyond Grade A with a medium build spoke with a deep voice.

"We want to ask for the opinions of the upper echelons. Can you give us a communicator?"

Han Xiao glanced at him and recognized that this was a direct descendant valued by the Supercluster. His name was Mablo, and he was very strong. Unfortunately, he had died in the Tragedy of the Pinnacles.

"Sure, take it."

Han Xiao did not reject this request. He took out a communicator and threw it to Mablo.

This was the condition of his deal with the Supercluster. With the rich experience of the Supercluster, they would definitely suspect that the three Universal Civilizations had secretly done something to their high-level combatants during the war. They would definitely not allow the strong who had finally revived to participate in the war. Han Xiao did not expect all of the revived direct descendants of the Supercluster to participate in the war.

Mablo took the communicator, nodded slightly, and led the other nine direct descendants of the Supercluster to the side to contact the upper echelons.

For a moment, all the revivors fell silent. The acquaintances exchanged glances and hesitated to speak.

This time, Reeve exhaled and slowly said, "Since the dynasty is in trouble, I will not shirk my duty. Isn't it just a war? As long as the dynasty gives the order, I am willing to contribute my strength."

"Hmm, me too."

"I'm already a dead man. Since the Federation needs my strength to fight against foreign enemies, there's no harm in burning it again."

With Reeve taking the lead, many of the direct descendants of the three Universal Civilizations expressed their support.

Seeing this, Han Xiaoxin heaved a sigh of relief.

The support of most of the direct descendants of the civilizations was within his expectations. The high-level combatants who had been educated by the three Universal Civilizations for a long time were naturally reliable, and they were willing to contribute their strength to the explored universe.

However, when it came to a second life, things obviously would not go so smoothly. When many of the direct descendants expressed their stance, a voice of dissent appeared in the crowd.

"Black Star, I'm sorry, but we don't want to continue participating in the war."

Han Xiao and the others looked in the direction of the voice, and their expressions changed.

The revivor who spoke was not a historical powerhouse but an association member who had died on the battlefield not long ago. His name was Garoze, and he had a short interaction with Han Xiao.

The other association members who had died in battle also followed beside Garoze. Clearly, they had reached a consensus and mustered up their courage to look at Han Xiao.

As expected, even the Beyond Grade As who were willing to participate in the war did not want to take the risk after dying once …

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. Although he was not surprised, he still shook his head and sighed.

However, before he could respond, another revivor objected.

"I'm sorry, but I don't plan to participate in this war either."

Han Xiao turned around, and his expression changed.

The person who spoke was Hilbert, the first direct descendant of the three Universal Civilizations who refused to respond to the recruitment.

Reeve looked at him in surprise. "You're …"

Before she could finish, Hilbert waved his hand and interrupted her. He said calmly, "Don't worry.

"I've already sacrificed my life for the three Universal Civilizations and fulfilled my duty. I've done them justice. Even if I'm a direct descendant, Ethereal can't ask me to contribute endlessly. Even the upper echelons have the choice to retire. Furthermore, I've died once, and everything is reset. It's not easy for me to have a second chance. I can't work for them forever."

As soon as he said that, many of the direct descendants of the civilizations who were still conflicted were stunned. They felt that what he said hit the nail on the head and could not help but nod in agreement.

Even the direct descendants of the civilizations who had already expressed their stance were shaken by these words.

The direct descendants of the three Universal Civilizations originally wanted to persuade them, but when they heard this, they were speechless.

"This doesn't seem good …"

Seeing this, the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations who were remotely monitoring the situation felt their hearts tighten.
